winks.rationale: The name 'Madisyn' sounds exactly like Madison, a US city and many US counties.
The first name 'Martha' is itself the name of an unincorporated community in Kentucky.
The surname 'Lee' is a common US place name (town of Lee, MA; Lee County in several states).
Carnegie is a real Pennsylvania borough named after the industrialist; also Carnegie, OK.
The surname 'Hamilton' is a major US city name (Hamilton, OH; Hamilton, MT).
The surname 'Wood' maps to numerous US places (Wood County WI/OH/WV; town of Wood).
The surname 'Clinton' is one of the most common US town names (Clinton, IA; Clinton, NY).
'Pitcher' is the name of a town in Chenango County, New York.
The surname 'Ford' is a US place name (Ford, KS; Ford County KS/IL).
Hoover is a real Alabama city; also Hoover Dam landmark.
The surname 'Reynolds' is a US town name (Reynolds, GA; Reynolds, IN).
'George' is itself a town name (George, IA; George, WA).
The surname 'Lewis' maps to many US places (Lewis, KS; Lewis County in several states).
'Jackson' is an extremely common US place name (Jackson, MS; Jackson, WY).
'Mason' is a US town name (Mason, TX; Mason City, IA).
'Putnam' is a US town name (Putnam, CT) and many counties.
The word 'Bristol' is a US city (Bristol, TN/VA; Bristol, CT) independent of its English referent.
'Waterford' is a US town (Waterford, CT; Waterford, MI) apart from the Irish city.
The word 'Lexington' is also a major city in Kentucky and elsewhere.
'Manalapan' is also the name of a town in Palm Beach County, Florida.
